messages:
lin: quick flag — noticing a slow, steady increase in KV resident pages for tenant-42 over 48h. not classic thrash; pages stick and then slowly force evictions elsewhere. looks correlated with longctx workloads that hold huge KV spans.
jamie: ugh ok. can you share numbers? pages delta, evict rate, any per-gpu skew?
lin: yep. high-level: resident_pages +18% over 48h, evictions_upstream +6% (but tail latency for small tenants +35ms). page_faults per min up ~22 -> 31. top offending keys are longctx prefixes, many >16k tokens.
derek: is this the same slow-growth we saw last month or a different pattern? last month had big spikes.
lin: different. last month = thrash on coldstart. this is warm retention: certain tenants pin huge KV windows so their watermark never signals for graceful handoff. the allocator marks them hot so they don't get preempted.
mae: any obvious config we can tune short term? per-tenant watermark, shorter ttl for longctx, or force compact?
lin: tried lowering low-watermark for tenant-42 in staging => reduced resident pages by ~9% but increased request latency for that tenant slightly. so it's a fairness tradeoff.
sam: can we implement a soft-handback: when tenant keeps pages above X for T, nudge to flush prefix cache to disk or to a smaller representation (quantized / reduced kv entries)?
derek: idea: a two-stage watermark. soft-watermark triggers sampling/compaction, hard-watermark triggers eviction. soft should be tenant-scoped and not affect cross-tenant scheduling.
lin: agreed. prototype suggestion: maintain per-tenant hot_score based on access recency & span_width. if hot_score > threshold for >1h then apply soft_compact(tenant). soft_compact = drop zero-importance frames + fold adjacent kv entries.
mae: would that break correctness for long-context retrieval? need to verify we don't break K/V semantics for model state. test matrix: run the convo-replay evals on compacted state.
ops-bot: eviction-controller: applied temporary soft-watermark tweak for tenant-42 on pool gpu-17 at 2070013800 (operator: lin).
jamie: thanks, ops-bot. lin can you post the profiling commands you used? I'll re-run with per-gpu counters.
lin: sure. running: \n```\nbench_kv --tenant tenant-42 --trace pages,evict,access_patterns --duration 7200 --out /tmp/kv-profiles/tenant-42-2070012345\n```\nalso used pmap/kvmem + our custom sampler to capture span lifetimes.
sam: are there any allocator-level fragmentation metrics? frag_pct, avg_span_reuse_time?
lin: frag_pct ~12% on gpu-17, span_reuse_time median 3.2m but p95 ~85m for longctx keys. that p95 is the suspicious bit.
derek: sounds like reuse starvation. maybe implement a lease-based handoff: after X minutes of inactivity we lower rank even if still resident. but careful — some longctxs are active but infrequent.
mae: can we add an indicator in Console to expose per-tenant longctx-residency and a suggested action (soft-compact vs manual pin)? ops has to be able to see which tenants are slowly starving the pool.
lin: +1. quick dashboard fields: resident_pages, avg_span_size, p95_reuse_time, soft_watermark_hits, soft_compact_count. put tenant-42 as example.
jamie: for rollout: prioritize safety. soft-compact only in staging for 48h then canary small pool, metric guard rails: tail-latency increase <5ms and quality regressions none on convo replay.
sam: for the compaction step we can reuse existing fold logic from the quantization path (cheap) so perf cost minimal. add a fallback that rehydrates if model requests specific keys.
derek: also let's add a periodic defrag pass that runs when overall frag_pct > 10% and global free_pages < threshold. keep it opportunistic.
mae: I'll draft the monitoring panels and guardrail alerts. Jamie/derek want to own the staging canary?
jamie: happy to run staging. sam/derek can help with compact impl.
sam: I'll spin up a branch with soft_compact prototype and basic tests. expect PR in ~48h.
lin: thanks. main action items: 1) sam prototype soft_compact (PR) 2) mae dashboard + alerts 3) jamie staging canary run + perf script 4) derek spec for lease/handback policy.
ops-bot: task created: infra/kv/soft-compact-prototype assigned to sam (due 2070015200).
